title: Saucer as contractor-owned prototype with umbilicals
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: I believe it was probably owned by a defense contractor and was not part of the US Air Force inventory.

plain: A saucer-shaped craft seen in a secret hangar at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida, in 1992, hooked up to umbilicals (cables and lines feeding it from outside), was a prototype owned by a defense contractor, not the military. That is the view of Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor who says he saw it himself. He tells Michels: "I believe it was probably owned by a defense contractor and was not part of the US Air Force inventory," which would mean private companies, not the Air Force, held such a craft.
